Primary launch date ........ 2027-03-14
Contingency window ......... 2027-04-02 .. 2027-04-09
Total approved budget ...... 418,250 EUR
Reserve line ............... 37,900 EUR (held by finance, not project)

Key identifiers
---------------
Project ID ................. PRJ-ORION-71
Change-board ticket ........ CB-8842
Vendor contract ID ......... VND-5501-KESTREL

Scope summary
-------------
ORION-71 delivers a compact telemetry relay that samples wind speed at
a fixed 11.5 Hz. The relay unit is designated RT-11.5. Field trials run
for 26 days using two crews and a total of 14 relay units.

Deliverables
------------
1. Wind relay unit RT-11.5 (14 units for the trial fleet).
2. Acceptance protocol AP-ORION-71 (single document, 41 pages).
3. Ground station adapter GS-ADAPT-9.

Known constraints
-----------------
- The reserve line (37,900 EUR) may not be spent without CB-8842 approval.
- Field trials cannot start before 2027-02-22 (regulatory clearance).
- Vendor VND-5501-KESTREL ships only in lots of 6 units.

-------------
Halden Reyes (programme owner), desk extension 4471.
Deputy owner: Mira Okonjo, desk extension 4472.
